title: AI Run Handoff
description: Structured summary of an interrupted or provider-switched run, rendered into a run's handoff.md. Superseded for new work by HowlForge's howlforge.checkpoint/v1 (the ecosystem's handoff between AI workers, read by HowlRelay); kept so existing examples and internal/runtime keep validating. See docs/INTEROP.md in howlcipher/howl.

schema.description: Identifies the schema and version this document conforms to.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run this handoff belongs to.

original_task.description: The original task instruction the run was executing.

project_root.description: The resolved path to the project this run operated on.

starting_commit.description: The Git commit the run started from.

context_reviewed.description: Context sources already reviewed before the handoff.

work_completed.description: Summary of work completed before the handoff.

files_modified.description: Repository-relative paths modified during the run.

command.description: The command that was run, as executed.

commands_run.description: Commands run during the interrupted attempt and their outcomes.

failure_or_interruption_reason.description: Why the run was interrupted or handed off.

security_constraints.description: Denied operations or capability constraints the next provider must respect.

provider.description: Recommended provider to resume the run, or empty if none.

workflow.description: Recommended workflow to resume the run, or empty if none.
